info.title: InsightAI Fraud Detection API
info.description: APIs for fraud detection, prevention, bulk processing, and initial customer data load.

post.description: Analyzes transaction data for potential fraud and returns a detailed fraud report.

requestBody.description: Transaction details to analyze for fraud.

post.description: Uploads a bulk set of transactions for fraud analysis.

requestBody.description: A file containing multiple transactions in CSV or JSON format.

get.description: Retrieves the fraud detection report for a specific transaction ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Transaction ID for which the fraud detection report is requested.

post.description: Loads first-time customer data into the system for fraud prevention and risk profiling.

requestBody.description: Customer data file in CSV or JSON format containing necessary details for onboarding.

400.description: Invalid customer data or file format

post.description: Checks the loan eligibility of a customer based on the provided financial and personal details.

requestBody.description: Customer details for loan eligibility check.

post.description: Uploads a bulk set of customer details for loan eligibility check.

requestBody.description: A file containing multiple customer details in CSV or JSON format.

get.description: Fetches the results of the bulk loan eligibility check.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: The ID of the bulk processing task to fetch results for.

400.description: Invalid task ID or bulk results not available

post.description: Extracts chargeback-related details from the provided email content.

requestBody.description: The email content containing chargeback information to be analyzed.

200.description: Chargeback details extracted from the email content.

400.description: Email content missing in the request body.

500.description: Failed to parse the response JSON.

get.description: Retrieves a detailed real-time risk alert for a specific tenant ID.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: Tenant ID for which the risk alert report is requested.

200.description: Risk alert payload containing risk score, flags, device details, network info, and decision reasons.

post.summary: Analyse document for forgery and inconsistencies
post.description: Performs document forgery analysis, layout anomaly detection, future-date inconsistencies, cross-field mismatches, and text manipulation traces.

document.description: Document file to be analysed (PDF, PNG, JPG, etc.)

200.description: Document forgery analysis result containing anomaly detections, tampering indicators, and confidence scores.

post.description: Creates a new dynamic risk rule in the rule engine.

400.description: Malformed JSON or missing required fields

422.description: Invalid rule logic or unsupported operator

get.description: Retrieves a list of all currently active rules in the engine.

value.message: The provided authentication token is invalid or expired.
You do not have permission to access rule data.
An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

delete.description: Deletes a rule permanently from the rule engine using its unique rule ID.

parameters.name: rule_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the rule to be deleted.

post.description: Evaluates a transaction against all active rules and returns a risk decision.

value.message: Invalid JSON structure in request body.
Operator 'gt' cannot be applied to field 'vpa'.
Transaction evaluation failed due to an internal error.

triggered_rules.description: List of rule names that were triggered.

v.description: Schema version of the risk alert event.

tier.description: Risk engine tier indicating the evaluation mode.

ts.description: Timestamp at which the risk alert was generated.

seq.description: Sequence number of the alert, useful for ordering events.

stream.description: Metadata related to the tenant and organization origin of the event.

data.description: Core risk evaluation payload including decision, risk score, entity details, and correlation signals.

alert_id.description: Unique identifier assigned to the risk alert.

note.example: Block purchase attempt; device shows automation & abnormal velocity.

accountId.description: ID of the account associated with the transaction.

accountType.description: Type of the account (e.g., savings, current).

status.description: Status of the fraud detection process.

isFraudulent.description: Indicates whether the transaction is flagged as fraudulent.

details.description: Detailed explanation of the fraud detection result.

response.description: List of detected anomalies or validation checks performed.

issue.description: Type or label of the detected issue.

observation.example: There are inconsistent spaces after colons in various sections...

tampered.description: Indicates whether this issue likely represents tampering.

tampering_type.description: Category of tampering or mismatch detected.

document_url.description: Temporary URL to access the stored document.

file.description: CSV or JSON file containing multiple transactions.

caseId.description: String Id to represent the case analysis of the bulk transaction

fraudulentCount.description: Number of transactions flagged as fraudulent.

analyticsJson.description: JSON of all the transaction flagged and score for each

isFraudulent.description: Indicates if the transaction is fraudulent.

riskScore.description: Risk score associated with the transaction.

explanation.description: Detailed explanation of the fraud analysis.

file.description: CSV or JSON file containing customer details.

status.description: Status of the data load process.

loadedCount.description: Number of customer records successfully loaded.

failedCount.description: Number of records that failed to load.

eligibility.description: Indicates whether the customer is eligible for a loan.

recommended_loan_amount.description: The amount recommended to be sanctioned to the customer.

interest_rate.description: Interest rate applicable on the loan.

file.description: The bulk file containing multiple customer loan details (CSV/JSON).

task_id.description: A unique ID generated for the bulk processing task.

status.description: Status of the bulk processing request (e.g., 'processing', 'completed').

task_id.description: The task ID for the bulk loan check.

results.description: The results of the bulk loan eligibility check.

email_content.description: The email content containing chargeback-related information to be analyzed.

transaction_entity.description: Name of the merchant, bank, or gateway involved in the transaction.

currency.description: Currency of the transaction (e.g., USD, INR).

chargeback_reason.description: Reason for the chargeback, if available.

customer_email.description: Email address of the customer (if provided).

customer_phone.description: Phone number of the customer (if provided).

additional_notes.description: Any extra information or instructions extracted from the email.
